trap.label: incontáveis no plural
trap.wrong: I need some informations and advices.
trap.right: I need some information and advice.
trap.why: Em português informação e conselho têm plural; em inglês information, advice, bread e water são incontáveis.

rewrite.prompt: Complete com much/many: “How ___ sugar do you want?” Escreva a pergunta completa.
rewrite.answer: How much sugar do you want?

rewrite.prompt: Complete com much/many: “How ___ apples do you have?” (frase completa)
rewrite.answer: How many apples do you have?
